automation_evidence.quote: it performs expert selection through an LLM-based selector that chooses the most suitable forecasting model for each task from a pool of state-of-the-art forecasters.

evidence.quote: First, it enables context-aware forecasting by combining numerical history with external contextual inputs to refine lookback windows, detect anomalies, and anticipate future effects.

summary: An LLM selects forecasting experts and adapts forecasts using external context; the README reports no results, only pointers to GIFT-Eval and GIFT-CTX.
